paite: Huchi in amasapen in thilnget thumnate, thumna himhimte, thumsaknate, leh kipahthu gennate, mi tengteng a ding a bawlsak ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
heading: Saptuam Biakna

paite: Kumpipate leh thuneite tengteng a ding in leng; Pathian limsak leh zahtakhuaitak a kituak a khamuang a i omtheihna ding in.
Huai tuh i Hondampa Pathian theih in ahoih in, akipahhuai hi.
Ama'n mi tengteng hotdam a om ding leh thutak thei ding in adeih hi.
"Pathian khat kia a om, Pathian leh mihing kikal ah palai khat kia a-om nawn,
Amah mihing ahi, Khrist Jesu, mi tengteng tatna dia kipepa pen." Huai theihpihna ahuntak a piak ahi.
Hiai hih ding a tangkoupihpa ding leh sawltak a seh ka hi, Khrist ah thutak tak ka gen, ka zuau kei; ginna leh thutak a Zentelte sinsakpa a seh ka hi.
Pasalte'n mun chih a khut siangthou zak in, thangpai lou leh ginglel lou in thum le uh ka deih hi.
heading: Biakna A Numeite Omdan Ding

paite: Huchibang mah in numeite zumthei leh omdan siam in puansilh kilawm lel in kivan le uh; samphek, dangka-eng, tuikepsuang leh puan mantam taktakte a kivan lou in;
himahleh numei Pathian limsak kichite akihun lel in thil hihhoih in kivan le uh ka deih hi.
Numei in thumang hiathiat in om dinden in zil hen.
Himahleh numei in thu ahilh zaw ka phal kei, pasal tung a thuneih leng ka phal sam kei, dai dinden in om zaw hen.
Adam siam masak ahi a, huai nung in Evi siam ahi.
Adam khem in a-om kei a, numei khem in a-om a, tatlekna ah apukta hi.
Numei in omdan siamna toh ginna leh itna leh sianthouna a a-om gigeleh nau pianna ah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
